adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0)) && (await isTeamOwner(user.id, booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0))`, which requires the user to be both admin AND owner. The subsequent auth gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN` will incorrectly deny team admins who are not owners. Additionally, for non-team bookings (`teamId` null/undefined), both membership checks are still executed against `teamId ?? 0`, causing unnecessary queries and potentially unintended semantics for teamId 0.
